git push -u origin fix/7-refresh-infinite-recursion 2>&1 | tail -3 && gh pr create --base main --head fix/7-refresh-infinite-recursion --title "Fix infinite recursion in refresh() on expired session" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fixes #7.

## Cause
\`refresh()\` in \`src/auth.js\` called \`refresh(session)\` with the same expired session, so it recursed forever and the page froze.

## Change
- Returns the session unchanged when it is still valid.
- When expired, returns \`fetchSession()\` instead of recursing.
- \`fetchSession\` is passed in as a parameter. **It does not exist anywhere in this repo yet**, so the issue's reference could not be wired to a real import. Callers must supply it, and \`refresh\` is now \`async\`.

## Testing
- \`node --check\` passes.
- Ad-hoc check: a valid session returns as-is without calling \`fetchSession\`; an expired session returns the result of \`fetchSession\`.
- No test suite exists in the repo.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)" 2>&1
